items.t: Clay High School student dressed in tactical gear arrested
items.x: A Clay High School student was arrested Friday after showing up to school dressed in camouflage, “commando-style” tactical gear, triggering a security response and disrupting the school day, according to the Clay County Sheriff’s Office.

items.t: Clay High student arrested for coming to school in 'commando-style' attire
items.x: The Clay County Sheriff's Office says that the student was charged with a misdemeanor for disrupting a school function.

items.t: Clay County voters to decide whether to remove $37,000 salary cap for commissioners
items.x: A charter amendment on the ballot would remove the $37,000 cap on commissioner salaries in Clay County.

items.t: Decades after their first wins, Roger Howarth and Beth Maitland win at Daytime Emmys
items.x: Roger Howarth and Beth Maitland have swept the supporting acting categories at the Daytime Emmys.

items.t: Astros hire Randy Flores as general manager. Former pitcher had been assistant GM with Cardinals
items.x: The Houston Astros have hired St. Louis Cardinals executive Randy Flores as their general manager.

items.t: Chet Holmgren out at least 2 months with knee injury and Cason Wallace has shoulder surgery
items.x: Chet Holmgren will miss about two months because of a right knee injury, continuing the Oklahoma City Thunder’s run of bad injury news early in the season.

items.t: Lawmakers and veterans call on VA to make rare muscle disease a presumptive condition
items.x: A bipartisan letter signed by 54 lawmakers calls on the Dept. of Veterans Affairs to make inclusion body myositis (IBM) a presumptive service-connected condition.

items.t: Pedestrian critically injured after crash on US-1 at SR-312 in St. Augustine
items.x: A pedestrian was airlifted to the hospital on Friday night after a crash on US-1 and State Road 312 in St. Augustine, according to the St. Johns County Fire Rescue.

items.t: 2 helicopters crash midair in Oregon, killing an experienced pilot, instructor and student
items.x: Two helicopters collided near a small Oregon airport, killing an experienced pilot, an instructor and a student.

items.t: Ten days of fair food, rides and competition: The Florida Gateway Fair kicks off in Lake City
items.x: Columbia County Fair opens, update on rodeo arena that collapsed over the summer.

items.t: Selma Blair personally addresses flight incident arrest for first time
items.x: Actress Selma Blair publicly addressed for the first time her October arrest following an incident on a flight to New York.

items.t: Graphika finds China-linked Spamouflage accounts posing as US voters on X
items.x: Analysts at Graphika report that the influence campaign known as Spamouflage is active ahead of the midterm elections.

items.t: Hughes wins Breeders' Cup Juvenile, establishes himself as early Kentucky Derby favorite
items.x: Unbeaten favorite Hughes established himself as an early Kentucky Derby favorite by taking control through the far turn and pulling away for a 2 1/4-length victory over American History in the $2 million Breeders’ Cup Juvenile at Keeneland.

items.t: Ground cinnamon recalled in 14 states over possible lead contamination
items.x: Wise Wife ground cinnamon sold in 14 states was recalled after state testing found the spice may contain elevated levels of lead.

items.t: Nikita Kucherov tells Lightning he won't re-sign and asks for a trade, AP source says
items.x: Reigning NHL MVP Nikita Kucherov informed the Tampa Bay Lightning he is not re-signing with the team and has asked for a trade, a person with knowledge of the situation tells The Associated Press.

items.t: Pope Leo XIV has become the first pope in history to vote in a US general election
items.x: Pope Leo XIV, formerly Robert Prevost, “has exercised his right to vote as a United States citizen” and has done so “whenever he was eligible to do so."

items.t: St. Augustine vs. Mandarin updates
items.x: The Varsity 4 Game of the Week could be a classic. The Mustangs came back in a thriller last year for a 27-21 win at St. Augustine to deny the Yellow Jackets a perfect regular season.

items.t: Christa Pike says she feels constant pain in her first statement since failed Tennessee execution
items.x: Christa Pike said she is in constant pain since surviving a lethal injection in Tennessee last month but is thankful for the love and support she has received.

items.t: Wiring thefts keep Wonderwood Bridge dark as FDOT works to stop thieves
items.x: Wiring thefts have left parts of Jacksonville’s Wonderwood Bridge dark, raising safety concerns as FDOT adds cameras and stronger protections to stop thieves

items.t: Speed ticket cameras coming to Highway 40 near Kingsland Elementary
items.x: The speed ticket cameras accompany a 20-mile-per-hour increase in the speed limit from 35 MPH to 55 MPH during school zone hours.
